about: The last stretch of the scroll rebuilt in 3D (world.html?scene=end): Dr. Zhao's shop and its neighbours, the square well, the stalls under their parasols, the halls across the street, and the willows where the painting stops. Same world as the Rainbow Bridge (see world-bridge.json), all of it land. Build with tools/make_world.py.

loader: Raising Dr. Zhao’s street out of the painting…
page.label: The street of Dr. Zhao's shop from Along the River During the Qingming Festival, rebuilt in 3D, with a porter you can walk along it and a camera that goes all the way round
page.description: Dr. Zhao’s shop and the end of Along the River During the Qingming Festival, rebuilt in 3D from the painting: walk the porter who is painted there.
text: The street is the painting itself, laid back down on the ground it shows: from the painter’s own direction it lines up with the scroll exactly. Dr. Zhao’s shop, the houses beside it, the well, the stalls and the halls across the street are rebuilt as simple models dressed in their own painted timbers and tiles, so you can walk round them.

The people are the painting’s own, each cut out of the scroll and stood up where they are painted, with the willows where the scroll ends. The painting only ever shows one side of things, so a model’s far side wears its near side, mirrored.

Your walker is the porter painted right here, with two baskets on a shoulder pole: he starts where he stands in the scroll. He can go anywhere along the street, but not through a building or into the well; hold Shift to hurry. He, and everyone else, turns to face you like a paper cut-out.
The sounds are synthesized, not recorded.

pois.title: Dr. Zhao’s shop
pois.body: Its sign reads 赵太丞家, “the house of Zhao, court physician”. Inside, two women with a child stand at the counter.

pois.title: The remedy boards
pois.body: The tall boards by the door advertise 集香丸, pills “truly prescribed for harm done by wine”.

pois.title: A square well
pois.body: A square well in the street, with a wooden curb round it and people drawing water.

pois.title: Where the painting stops
pois.body: A few steps past the shop the painting simply stops, among the willows. Several scholars have suspected that the scroll was cut short here.
